findings.label: String-coupled fallback trigger
findings.detail: The non-streaming retry fires only when the error message contains one of four hardcoded phrases (streaming is not supported / stream is not supported / does not support stream / stream not supported). A server that rejects streaming with different wording (e.g. HTTP 400 'stream unsupported for this model') would miss all four and surface as a hard request failure instead of falling back. Consider a shared constant or broader match to make the contract explicit.

findings.label: Shim streaming behavior unverifiable headlessly
findings.detail: Whether the shim delivers genuinely incrementally versus effectively batched depends on a live LM Studio server and cannot be confirmed by type-check/build. Flagged in the verification note; worth a manual smoke test against a real server.
